notes.title: Update 24.12.15
notes.content:
Hey Community,

we released the latest update 1.0.19. We have changed the main Map. This gives us more space to expand the content. We know the controller is not the best but...

...The update on 12/28/15 brings a completely worked controller. 
* 4 new weapons
* more powerups
* fixet the bug on the weapon box 



Let us know your wishes
Merry Christmas

tags.bug: * fixet the bug on the weapon box
